mentions.name: NameTheory
mentions.description: NameTheory is an iOS domain search app that uses Apple Intelligence to help brainstorm domain name ideas, built to explore what small local models can do. It is the author's first iOS app, created as a simple tool that scratches a personal itch.
mentions.source_excerpt: A domain search app called NameTheory: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nametheory-domain-search/id6808794544
